newsitem.title: NORWAY: Zurich Insurance makes formal bid for Protector.
newsitem.headline: Zurich Insurance makes formal bid for Protector.

text.p: Zurich Insurance Company of Switzerland has formally put forward an offer to shareholders of Norwegian insurer Protector ASA, a statement on the Oslo bourse said on Thursday.
After a period of due diligence, Zurich Insurance has offered 230 crowns per share of Protector, six crowns above the Norwegian group's closing price of 224 crowns on Wednesday.
The offer is dependent on Zurich Insurance obtaining acceptances from 90 percent of Protector shareholders.
Protector, listed on the Oslo bourse in 1992, has developed a position the international marine and energy insurance markets and the Norwegian commercial/industrial sector.
